## Projects Department Health & Safety Standards

Ref:EGY/PRJCTS/HSE/REQs

## 2.4.4.3. Machinery, Tools & Equipment:

- It is important that machinery and equipment including powered tools are safe to use and operated by persons who have bcen traincd in thcir use.
- All machinery and equipment will be installed by a competent person and inspected before use by the users. They are to be fitted with suitable guards and interlocks to prevent body parts from coming into contact with moving parts.
- Fixed machinery is to be secured to prevent movement and during operation vices, jigs, push sticks or other similar devices are tobeused.
- Portable power tools such as hand held grinders, circular saws and drills are to be fitted with switches, levers, triggers that require constant pressure for operation and automatically stop when released.
- Section 4 of this document provide a comprehensive list of topics and required controls associated with keeping theworksite safe.

## 3. Site Standards for Operational Control

- >This section of the document identifies the Minimum Standards that Contractors and those engaged by them require to comply with at a site level to ensure adequate Operational Control of workplace health and safety risks.

## 3.1. Construction Planning and Design Management

- >A key element of ensuring safe and productive construction work is to integrate health and safety into the management of the project and to encourage everyone involved in the project to work together. Contractors are therefore required to detail what arrangements they will have in their HSP to:
- Improve the planning and management of the project from the very start involving subject matter experts to ensure that risks associated with all aspects of business, particularly in terms of hazardous activities are properly assessed
- ·Identify hazards early on, so they can be eliminated or reduced at the design or planning stage so that the remaining risks can be properly managed.
- ·Performingdesign andconstructabilityreviews
- oTarget effort where it can do the most impact in terms of health and safety; and
- Contractors are to include details of how they are going to ensure safety is considered at all stages of the design including opportunities for construction teams to feed into the design pfocess throughout its lifecycle.Where this is achieved through constructability/build ability reviews an invitationtoattendsuchreviewsistobeextended toEMAARMisr.
- Designers (architects, engineers etc.) carrying out design work arc to bc compctcnt and adcquately中 resourced to address the health and safety issues likely to be involved in the design.
